title: No plugins in plugin manager on first project?

posts.author: nyapaka
posts.body: Title says it all, almost. I verified in the files in Steam and it said everything looks good. I don't see any of the default plugins in the plugin manager.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
These? They are not activated by default and you'll have to pick them from the list. if this list is empty
Check your steamapps\common\RPG Maker MZ\newdata\js
If nothing's in there, mybe delete the newdata folder and try verifying again.

posts.author: nyapaka
posts.body:
OMG, thank you. I didn't realise I just needed to double click.
The instructions I was following told me to look for an add button. Also said they'd just show up when I opened the plugin manager. I won't use that resource anymore.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Well, MV comes with a couple pre-activated plugins, but that doesn't have an "add" button either. Maybe try to make sure you're reading actual MZ instructions and not some gpt generated mumbo jumbo or something.
